Definition: from G1537 and G2808; to shut out (literally or figuratively):--exclude.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to shut out or exclude, and Paul uses it twice, once for boasting and once for false teachers. Where is boasting then, he asks; it is excluded by the law of faith, and he says the Judaisers zealously affect the Galatians, but not well, because they want to exclude them and make them seek their favour instead. The word shuts the door on boasting and on those who would shut others out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faith shuts out boasting, because there is nothing left to boast about when salvation is a gift.
